messages:
Noah (Revenue): Quick triage: vendor credits from our reseller promo were booked as refunds to COGS instead of deferred contra-revenue. Seeing a $31,400 misstatement hitting March gross margin. Need guidance on JE and disclosure.
Elena (Billing): Which invoices/vendors? I have mapping for SKU RESL-ONRAMP-CR. Affected: INV-12088 (ResellCo) credit $20,000, INV-12102 (ChannelOne) credit $8,400, INV-12115 (EdgePartners) credit $3,000. Terms: credits offset future service over 10 months.
Mark (Controller): Materiality: ResellCo >25k so requires head finance sign-off. Also decide prior period correction vs normal adjustment.
Noah (Revenue): Billing exported amort schedule: ResellCo used 1 month, remaining amortizable $18,000; ChannelOne remaining $7,560; EdgePartners $2,700. Link to export: https://drive.google.com/file/d/reseller-credits-export (view).
Priya (Tax): Heads-up tax may care about timing; loop us after accounting draft.
Noah (Revenue): Proposed JEs to reclassify remaining balances as of 3/31:
DR 5005 COGS - Vendor Credits 28,260
CR 2375 Deferred Contra-Revenue 28,260
Memo: Reclass RESL-ONRAMP-CR to deferred contra-revenue; attach export and vendor agreements.
Taylor (Head FP&A): For ResellCo, because amount >25k and related to prior quarter, recommend prior period correction with disclosure in footnotes. For the others treat as current period corrections.
Elena (Billing): I'll add validation in billing rules: any SKU containing "RESL-" routes to deferred GL 2375. Opening ticket BC-4392.
ops-bot: Ticket BC-4392 created, owner -> billing-engineer.
Mark (Controller): Action items: 1) Noah post JEs in NetSuite with supporting CSV, label ResellCo JE as "PPC - Reseller credit reclass"; 2) Priya review tax impact; 3) Elena implement billing validation and unit tests; 4) Taylor prepare footnote language. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Tax): Will review and confirm if any tax provision adjustment needed.
Noah (Revenue): Posting JE now and will ping when NS-JE-573890 is up. Included original vendor credit memos in the JE.
ops-bot: NetSuite JE posted NS-JE-573890 status -> posted.
Taylor (Head FP&A): Draft footnote: "During post-close review, reseller onboarding credits were reclassified from COGS/refunds to deferred contra-revenue to reflect multi-month vendor consideration; ResellCo amount treated as prior period correction per policy."
Mark (Controller): Approved. Closing loop  please attach billing ticket and NetSuite JE to the month-end close pack.
